title: How I Turned My Life Around
passage:
People are often surprised by how I became the world's best fitness coach. Well, most people don't know this, but I used to be chubby. Actually, I was overweight. This was because I spent all my time and effort developing video games. Sounds like every teenager's dream, right? For some time, it was.

But I became lazy. I spent so much time looking at a computer screen that I didn't have any energy left to exercise. I ate burgers every day, and my health was going in the wrong direction. I even started to hate myself. Then I ended up in hospital. When the doctor said I was lucky to not be dead, it was a terrible feeling. I was frightened and began thinking about my life.

I realized I had to make a change. I had to burn off this fat so I could see my belt again. So I turned my life around. Now look at me. Whenever I think back to that time I was at death's door, it reminds me to eat healthier, work out harder, and just be the best me I can be.

So my advice? Stay positive. Always be brave and never accept failure because no goal is impossible.
